title: Pair density Shannon information measures and their $N$-dependent behaviour in diatomic molecular systems
summary: Pair density Shannon entropies and mutual information in position and in momentum space are calculated for two series of homonuclear and heteronuclear diatomic molecules using Hartree-Fock wave functions. The pair density entropy sum increases with the quality of the basis set. Mutual information, a measure of statistical correlation, is seen to be smaller in momentum space as compared to position space. The interpretation is that the momentum pair density is closer than the position pair density to a Hartree-like reference. The $N$-dependent behaviours of the entropy and mutual information…
